fields.description: Visitors with a nationality other than this country are treated as foreign nationals.
fields.label: Home Country

fields.description: Used as the expected check-out when a pass or invitation does not specify one.
fields.label: Default Checkout Time

fields.description: Each accompanying visitor on a group pass needs an ID Proof Type and number, so every person is screened against the blacklist by ID.
fields.label: Require ID for Every Group Member

fields.description: Leave OFF (the default) to require every declared item to be verified before a Check-In or Check-Out can be saved. Tick only if your site deliberately admits visitors without checking their declared items.
fields.label: Allow Gate Events Without Item Verification
Blacklist Action
fields.options:
Block Entry
Alert Only
Log Only

fields.description: Enable physical badge issuance for visitors. If disabled, visitors will only get QR codes.
fields.label: Enable Badge

fields.description: Superseded by 'Requires Physical Badge' on each Visitor Type. Retained only for sites that have not yet set that flag.
fields.label: Badge Required For (legacy)

fields.description: How far ahead a visit may be scheduled. 0 = no limit.
fields.label: Max Advance Booking (days)

fields.description: Longest multi-day pass allowed: Pass Valid Until may be at most this many days after the visit date.
fields.label: Longest Multi-Day Pass Allowed (days)

fields.description: ISD code applied to local mobile numbers, without '+'.
fields.label: Default Phone Country Code

fields.description: Body temperature at or above which a Contact Trace Record's exposure risk is classified High. Health policy differs by site and authority.
fields.label: Fever Threshold (°C)

fields.description: Leave OFF (the default) so that only visitors who hold an invitation link can use the public pre-registration form; without one the form shows a message and the server refuses the submission and its uploads. Tick to let anyone who has the form's address register a visit to any employee without an invitation.
fields.label: Allow Pre-Registration Without Invitation

fields.description: Guest pre-registration submissions allowed per identity, per hour, before the public portal rate-limits further attempts. 0 is read as unset (falls back to the default), not as no limit.
fields.label: Max Portal Submissions per Hour

fields.description: One page path per line, e.g. /job_application. Guest file uploads from any page other than the visitor pre-registration form are refused while Visitor Management keeps 'Allow Guests to Upload Files' on for its portal — the same as Frappe does with that setting off. List another app's public form here to let its visitors upload again. Not needed if guest uploads were already on before this app was installed: those sites keep their own behaviour.
fields.label: Other Pages That May Accept Guest Uploads

fields.description: Visit windows overlapping these slots auto-derive the meal plan.
fields.label: Meal Windows

fields.description: Who receives VMS alerts. Leave a table empty to fall back to the built-in role list.
fields.label: Notification Recipients

fields.description: Notified when a blacklisted visitor is matched.
fields.label: Security Alert Roles

fields.description: Receive the daily hospitality schedule digest.
fields.label: Hospitality Digest Roles

fields.description: DPDP / GDPR-style data minimisation for visitor identity data. OFF by default — nothing is ever deleted or anonymised unless this is explicitly turned on.
fields.label: Data Retention & Purge

fields.description: When ticked, a nightly job anonymises name, mobile, email, ID number and photos on visits that are already over (Checked-Out, Rejected, Cancelled or No-Show) and older than the retention period. The visit record itself — dates, host, gate, badge, workflow history — is kept for audit and statistics. Leave this OFF until your compliance/legal function has confirmed a retention period: this app never purges anything on its own.
fields.label: Enable Data Retention Purge

fields.description: How long, after a visit is over, its identity data is kept before being anonymised. Only takes effect once Enable Data Retention Purge is ticked.
fields.label: Retention Period (days)

fields.description: Controls how the public pre-registration page looks. The whole palette is derived from the brand colour, so one setting themes the page.
fields.label: Portal Branding

fields.description: Used for step markers, focus rings and the submit button.
fields.label: Brand Colour

fields.description: Shown above the form title. Leave blank to show no logo.
fields.label: Portal Logo

fields.description: Shown beside the logo and in the page footer.
fields.label: Organisation Name

fields.description: Optional line under the form — e.g. a privacy statement or help contact.
fields.label: Footer Note

fields.description: Each Security user then records gate events only at the gates that list them under Assigned Security Users. A Security user listed on no gate can still use every gate.
fields.label: Security can only log at their assigned gates

fields.description: Check-out asks the guard to confirm the visitor handed back their badge.
fields.label: Ask for the badge back at check-out

fields.description: The first approval step goes to the host's Reports To manager instead of everyone with the approver role. A host with no manager (or a manager with no user) stays with the approver role. A second step, such as CEO, always stays with its role.
fields.label: Send approvals to the host's own manager

fields.description: A pass still waiting this long is sent to its approvers again, in the bell and by email, at most once per this many hours.
fields.label: Remind approvers after (hours, 0 = off)

fields.description: Each of these is on unless you untick it.
fields.label: Optional Features

fields.description: Security can open a short New Walk-In form for a visitor who arrives without a pass. The pass still goes through the normal approvals.
fields.label: Let Security register walk-in visitors

fields.description: The gate warns the guard when a visitor checks in before or after the time booked on their pass.
fields.label: Warn at the gate outside the booked time

fields.description: The host gets an email when their visitor is marked a no-show.
fields.label: Tell the host when a visitor does not show up

fields.description: The visitor gets a thank-you email after they check out.
fields.label: Send the visitor a thank-you email

fields.description: The visitor is emailed when their meal, cab or room booking is confirmed.
fields.label: Email the visitor about their bookings

fields.description: An approver who rejects a pass must type a reason. Untick to make the reason optional.
fields.label: Ask for a reason when a pass is rejected

fields.description: Minutes before the booked check-in or after the booked check-out a visitor may arrive or leave before the guard is warned. 0 warns at once.
fields.label: Gate Time Tolerance (minutes)
